duplicator PROXY POOL CHECKER Proxy pool checker PROXY Checking, adding and removing proxies Views via proxy Views: 3.2K This section allows boosting views on publications in Telegram channels using proxies without involving personal accounts. It is important to note that this feature works only in public channels, and these views are not reflected in Telegram's statistics. Setup process: Channels The user specifies either a channel link or a specific post link. The boosting will apply to all channel publications or individual posts, depending on the chosen link. The data is entered as a list. Number of views per post Enter an approximate number of views for each post. Proxies with IP rotation may produce an inaccurate count since repeated IPs are not counted as unique. Number of posts within the channel Specify how many of the most recent pieces of channel content should have their views boosted. For example, you can boost views on the last 5 posts. Delay This setting determines the pause between views, helping to regulate the speed and smoothness of the boosting process. Streams control The «Streams сontrol» option allows configuring the task's execution speed: the more threads, the faster the task will be completed. Boosting through proxies is not reflected in Telegram's statistics and is only intended for visually increasing views. Proxies with traffic-based payment consume a lot of data. It is better to use proxies with unlimited traffic to avoid unnecessary expenses. The module will start boosting views, distributing them evenly across the publications.
